group: Round 7 · Gear on the heroes: weapons in hand, armour worn
title: Weapons in hand 1: common and rare
use: Fixes the look of the held weapon models (game/js/entities/gear/weapons.js) for the common and rare weapons of loot.js.
prompt: A model sheet of blocky 3D voxel weapons, each a separate held model laid out in rows on a flat light-grey background at one shared scale (a hero's fist is one block), seen from the high three-quarter game angle with the grip at the bottom left and the point or head at the top right, as a hero holds it; each weapon readable at small size by its silhouette, with a small second view of its most distinctive part beside it. In this order: 1. Camp Training Sword, a plain bronze practice sword with a leather-wrapped grip; 2. Bronze Dagger, short and leaf-bladed; 3. Camp Spear, a wooden shaft with a bronze leaf head and a butt spike; 4. Cyclops Club, a turned wooden table leg; 5. Bronze Hand Axe, one-handed, the bit curving down; 6. Shepherd's Crook, a long wooden staff curling over at the top; 7. Celestial Bronze Xiphos, a leaf-shaped Greek sword glowing faintly gold; 8. Forge Hammer, a heavy two-handed iron hammer with glowing seams; 9. Reed Staff of Pan, a green reed staff with leaves, bound reed pipes and a frost-blue charm; 10. Electric Spear, a dark shaft with a bronze head and yellow lightning crackling at the tip; 11. Labrys of Knossos, a two-handed double-headed bronze axe; 12. Spartan Kopis, a forward-curved steel blade with a red grip; 13. Hoplite Dory, a long ash-wood spear with a big bronze head; 14. Empousa Fang, a curved white fang set in a bronze hilt; 15. Ram's-Horn Mace, an iron mace whose head is a ram's skull with curled horns; 16. Forge-Fire Sword, a blade still glowing orange from the forge; 17. Hunter's Moon Knives, a pair of silver hunting knives, one for each hand. 3D game art in the blocky voxel style of Minecraft Dungeons: characters built from cubes, with a large cube head whose face is simple pixel art (about 8 × 8 pixels: pixel eyes, a pixel mouth, hair drawn as pixels and as a few blocky tufts), a boxy torso, square arms and legs, crisp pixel-art textures (about 16 pixels per block) with simple shading, chunky readable silhouettes; warm cinematic lighting, soft ambient occlusion and glowing magic effects. Costume colours and details follow the Camp Half-Blood cartoon concept art. Palette: camp orange #f28c28, sea teal #0f6f73, deep navy #10233d, jade #2e8b6e, coral #e8664a, bronze gold #c9963a, lightning yellow #ffd84a, parchment cream #f4ead5, vase black #17130f and owl grey #8c96a3. No lettering, logos, captions or watermark.
